title: Listing a member's past-due Space memberships makes two database reads per membership in a loop.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/spaces/memberships.ts:658-662: for each row, await getSpaceById(row.space_id) and await readTiers(row.space_id, false).

WHY IT MATTERS: Rare (only failed-card memberships) but runs on a member surface; cost grows with number of Spaces and adds sequential latency.

FIX DIRECTION: Fetch spaces and tiers once with .in('id', ids) before the loop, or Promise.all.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
